Level 21 Parameter Sanity Diagnostics
=====================================

Purpose
-------
Check whether Level 21 improved the age-composition fit by creating
pathological tradeoffs among initial numbers, longline age selectivity,
purse-seine age selectivity, and recruitment deviations.

Interpretation
--------------
Large initial-number multipliers, especially paired with large selectivity
departures, indicate that Level 21 may be fitting composition data by
trading initial age structure against selectivity. If the initial-number
prior penalty dominates the improvement in objective, the next step should
be either tightening the initial-number prior or reducing selectivity freedom.
